RoomsContacts: The Contacts tab holds everyone in the room. Add contacts from your workspace here and give each one a role — from viewing files to managing the room.
RoomsCreateFirst: Pick a type, invite the people you work with, and drop in your files. It takes a minute — and everything you have just seen starts working on your own documents.
RoomsCreateOwn: Pick a type, invite the people you work with, and drop in your files. It takes a minute — and everything you have just seen starts working in rooms of your own.
RoomsEmpty: The rooms you have just seen were a preview. Rooms someone invites you to show up in this list, and everything you have been shown works the same way in them.
RoomsEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
RoomsGroups: Organize rooms by specific features to quickly find what you need. Create groups and switch between them right above the list.
RoomsPlacesArchive: {{archive}} — rooms you no longer work in, restorable anytime.
RoomsTemplates: Turn any room into a template — its settings, structure and files are saved. Create a new room from it in a click, all that's left is to add members.
RoomsTypesCollaboration: {{roomType}} — edit documents together with your team.
RoomsTypesCustom: {{roomType}} — flexible setup for your own scenario.
RoomsTypesPublic: {{roomType}} — access for external users via a link.
